title: SpaceX reports Q2 revenue of $4.29B from its connectivity division, which includes Starlink, $100B of cash and marketable securities, and a $47.5B order backlog (Nathan Bomey/Axios)
summary: Nathan Bomey / Axios: SpaceX reports Q2 revenue of $4.29B from its connectivity division, which includes Starlink, $100B of cash and marketable securities, and a $47.5B order backlog — SpaceX exceeded revenue expectations and reduced its losses in its initial quarter as a publicly traded company …
